summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX plan for the FAANG Path 2-Year DSA, CS Fundamentals & Resource Mastery Hub tailored for a 4-semester journey (Oct 2026 – 2nd Year), featuring a pre-loaded NeetCode 150 tracker with automatic 7-day spaced-repetition queues, in-browser 2-minute explanation voice recorder, searchable resource library, CS fundamentals & aptitude modules, GitHub-style analytics dashboard, and Firebase RBAC with Google Sign-In admin controls.
